resource.name: email-service
resource.description: Transactional email delivery for expense claim notifications: submission alerts to managers, and approval, return and export notifications to employees.

suggestions.name: SendGrid
suggestions.description: Simple send API with a generous free tier and good deliverability.

suggestions.name: Amazon SES
suggestions.description: Cheapest at volume, and inside the AWS account the organization already uses for S3 receipts.

suggestions.name: Mailgun
suggestions.description: Strong delivery analytics and bounce handling.

suggestions.name: Postmark
suggestions.description: Best transactional deliverability reputation, at a higher price.
